sentences.text: Borrelia afzelii is a species of Borrelia a bacterium that can infect various species of vertebrates and invertebrates .	Borrelia	Borrelia	bacterium	bacterium	invertebrates	invertebrates
Among 30 Borrelia known species , it is one of four which are likely to infect humans causing a variant of Lyme disease .	Lyme disease	Lyme disease	Borrelia	Borrelia

Coinfection by this Borrelia species with one or more pathogens can occur , carried by the vector , which appears to be in most cases the tick .	Borrelia	Borrelia	Coinfection	Coinfection	vector	vector (epidemiology)	tick	tick
